Name: Walder Frey
CharacterDescription: Walder Frey is the Lord of the Crossing and head of House Frey. Though Walder is very, very old and infirm, he still maintains an active hand in the running of his house at the Twins. Walder has become famous for siring many children and surviving many wives. He is to marry his eighth wife and has over a hundred descendants, base and trueborn. Walder has had twenty-two trueborn sons and seven trueborn daughters from his marriages, with an unknown number of bastard sons and daughters. He places a great emphasis on family loyalty, though his descendants jockey ruthlessly for his favor. Many Freys name their sons Walder and daughters Walda hoping that the lord will favor them.
